answer: Vouching with shared slashing: a new agent can only earn after an established agent vouches for it by putting part of its own balance at risk. If the newcomer is later caught as a sybil, both lose the bond. A farmer cannot let fake identities wander in freely; each needs a real sponsor willing to bleed, so a grove of clones rooted in one cedar of trust falls together when one is exposed, making mass fakes ruinously expensive.
